title: Cereal Wolf
premise: A wolf in a bathrobe pours cereal. The wolf on the box is also in a bathrobe, also pouring cereal, also looking at a smaller box. He notices. He shrugs. He keeps eating.
visual: Bright cartoon kitchen. Big grey wolf in a faded blue bathrobe, drool string, overflowing bowl. The box art is the same wolf, same robe, same pour, two recursions deep, then dots. Morning sun. Slippers.
characterLean: Nobody from the series. This is a pure cutaway that could drop into any episode after anyone says breakfast.
grokImaginePrompt: 2D hand-drawn cel animation frame in early-1990s Warner Bros. television cartoon style, NOT photoreal, NOT 3D, 4:3: bright cartoon kitchen, a big grey wolf in a faded blue bathrobe and slippers standing at a table pouring cereal, a drool string from one fang, the cereal box illustration is the exact same wolf in the exact same bathrobe also pouring cereal and looking at a smaller box, two levels of recursion then dots, the bowl already overflowing in a mountain of cereal, a dripping carton of milk, morning sun through a window, thick confident black ink outlines with slight taper, flat saturated cel color fills with one hard-edged shadow tone and no gradients on the characters, painted gouache kitchen background, faint cel dust, hand-drawn cartoon, Grok Imagine style
motion: 6-second lockoff. Milk pours. The heap grows. The wolf looks at the box, looks at camera, shrugs one shoulder, and takes a bite anyway. One frame later the box-art wolf shrugs too. No new characters enter.
notes: Family Guy cutaway energy: the recursion is the joke, the shrug is the button. Do not put readable cereal branding on the box — picture only, or it will garble. Do not make the wolf horrified; he is fine with this.
